notes.title: 'Spank Me Harder' DLC issue is fixed
notes.content:
Sinners, we finally got some support and as of earlier today the issue has been fix. if the DLC didn't automatically downloaded for you please try the following:

1. Use ‘Task Manager’ to kill Steam.exe
2. Launch Steam.exe
3. Select SinVR and uninstall the ‘Spank Me Harder’ DLC, then reinstall it

This will install the DLC and everything should work.
Thank you for your patience and have a Sinful holiday.
